Final Battle! The Dark Ultra Warrior
Lost Heroes
To an Unknown Cube

Main Quest 099
Main Quest 100
Explore the dungeon and find a way back to your original world
Zeta Gundam seems to be in this world too. Hurry and find and rescue Zeta Gundam
Chase the fleeing Spider Man and rescue Methuss
Wind has returned to Fuuto and the city's functions are restored. Explore beyond the doors that wouldn't open
The weaknesses of Seamons & Seagorath have been revealed! Defeat Seamons & Seagorath together with Mebius and Hikari!
Find Hikari, who went after Bogal
Find and protect Mebius, who was wounded shielding Hikari
A powerful enemy presence lurks deep in the area. Proceed with caution
Chase the fleeing Negataros!
Get the Denden Sensor, expose Weather Dopant's true form, and settle things!
Go check on Rider 1 and Rider 2, who were frozen in ice
The frozen Rider 1 and Rider 2 have vanished, and a teleporter has appeared. Are they beyond it? The teleporter may need investigating
A devastated world stretches out beyond the teleporter. Continue the search for Rider 1 and Rider 2
You will team up with Celestial Being and head for the enemy's base. Explore the Cube until the plan is set
Antlar, the magnetic kaiju, is blocking the Ride Gate. To defeat it, you must get the Blue Stone in the legendary town of Baraj
You got the Blue Stone in Baraj. Return to Antlar's nest and use the Blue Stone to head for the Ride Gate
To break into the Ride Dungeon, a Ride Machine will be built. Collect 3 materials and hand them to Hikari
Head out with Cherudim and Arios to retrieve Emerium ore!
Head out with Deathscythe and Birth to retrieve Gundanium alloy!
Raid the weapons depot with Sandrock and Heavyarms!
The Ride Machine is finally complete! Break through the Ride Dungeon and head for the enemy's base!
You sense a strange presence. Advance through the Cube with caution
Kamen Rider Black RX has been captured. Defeat The O and rescue Black RX!!
The O is going after the King Stone and has headed for Black RX! Save Black RX!!
You defeated The O and saved Black RX. With your new ally, head for the Hideout Cube!
The Ride Machine has been fitted with a drill. It should now be able to break through the Ride Dungeon's walls
Past the Ride Dungeon lies an eerie research facility. Explore it with caution
What tricks does this facility hold? Press on regardless
The grasp of modification surgery is closing in on Rider 1! Go rescue Rider 1
The Ultra Warriors are about to be executed! Go rescue the Ultra Warriors
To plug the modified Bemstar's belly mouth, you need a Polymer Plaster Bomb. Somewhere in the Cube there was a place with sticky ground...
You got the Polymer Plaster Bomb! Now you should be able to plug Bemstar's belly mouth!
With the modified Bemstar defeated, the heroes push deeper into the lab. Watch out for enemies and press on
Red King has blocked the passage with rocks. Look for another way
The heroes rescued Rider 1 and Rider 2. To smash the rocks blocking the passage, get a high-powered bomb from the armory
With Birth's help, you defeated the Giant Greeed (Berserk)! You got a Core Medal and rescued Kanegon. Head to the armory and find the high-powered bomb
You got the Spiner from the armory. Return to Red King and blast the rocks with the Spiner!
The rocks are destroyed and the crucifixion site is near. Are the Ultra Warriors safe? Rescue the Ultra Warriors
The heroes have rescued the Ultra Warriors. Giant Yapool awaits at the far end. Fight Giant Yapool and settle this!
The heroes saw an SOS Ultra Sign. Use the newly acquired drill and head for the next Cube in the Ride Machine!
The Ultras' home, the "Land of Light", is completely covered in ice. Explore the Cube to find the cause
The one who sent the Ultra Sign was Ultraman Belial, the strongest and worst ever produced by the Land of Light. Head for the Colosseum to join the game
The "game" was a martial arts tournament to decide the master of this Cube. Granzairas is defeated. Head to the venue for round 2
You beat the elite Over Flag squadron. Next up is Jashrine. Head to the venue for round 3
You beat the arch-villain Jashrine. Next up is the aquatic kaijin team led by Shiomaneking. Head to the venue for round 4
You beat the aquatic kaijin team. Next up is Mururoa. Head to the venue for round 5
You beat Mururoa. But Jack and the others lost. Head to the venue for round 6
You head to the match venue but no opponent shows up, and the venue is changed to Ultra Tower. 2 hours left. Hurry to the venue
The venue change was a trap set by the Alien Alliance. Somehow you defeat them in your wounded state. Hurry to Plasma Spark Tower!
Slipping past many traps, you reach the venue. God Gundam, a reliable ally, has joined you. Head to the venue for the finals, round 1
With the Core Medals taken from Uva, OOO has grown even stronger! Head to the venue for the finals, round 2
With Walter Gundam defeated, you finally hold a ticket to the finals. Head to the final venue and become the winner of the Fight!
The heroes have beaten Zamsha and Zetton, a subordinate of Master Gundam. Taro is right ahead. Rescue Taro!
Taro is safe and a new ally has joined. Take the Ride Gate at the back of Ultra Tower's top floor to a new Cube!
The new Cube was a museum displaying the items Gaoh's gang collected. Advance through the Cube with caution
Super Shocker has turned the Cube into a monster zoo that breeds kaiju and kaijin. Enemies are everywhere. Advance carefully
From talking with Taboo Dopant, you learn that W's Xtreme Memory is in this Cube. Press on to find the memory
You've reached a room with a mechanism. To proceed, you must solve the door's code. What is "GAIA's Memory"...?
You solved the puzzle and opened the door to a room displaying O Medals. Examine the display stands and search for Core Medals
Kazari stole the medals! Chase Kazari!
You got new Core Medals. But the Xtreme Memory is nowhere to be found. Keep exploring the Cube
You got a Key Ring from where Bogal Monst exploded. It might open the door to the special exhibition room. Check the doors that wouldn't open
You reached the special exhibition room, where the valuable items are kept. Search for the Xtreme Memory
Reach Taboo Dopant, who is at the back of the room!
The heroes learn the enemy's terrifying plan. To stop it, find the Gaia Gate. This Cube seems to have a hidden basement floor...
You defeated Tyrant and destroyed the device attached to the Gaia Gate. Find and destroy the remaining two
You defeated Shocker Greeed and destroyed the second device. Only one remains. Hurry
You defeated Terror Dopant and the others and stopped the Gaia Impact! Advance to a new Cube and carry out the next operation
To retake Veda, the heroes have reached a new Cube. Advance through the dungeon
Thanks to Cherudim and the others, you somehow got past the Virgo squad. Trust your allies and press on

notes.note: Source uses a different term for the plaster bomb than the glossary entry; rendered as the glossary Polymer Plaster Bomb.
The quoted Gaia-memory phrase rendered as GAIA's Memory.
Source has a trailing line break; dropped.

report: All 80 rows examined. Uncertain: 0.458 GAIA's Memory wording; 0.438 crucifixion site; 0.442 Colosseum (glossary has Ultra Colosseum). Not in glossary: Ultra Tower, Deathscythe (short form).
